audit_items.proof_trace: The validateBlobsByRange function sets upper bound to current slot (line 203-205) but never caps rp.end at FuluForkEpoch-1. In contrast, validateDataColumnsByRange explicitly starts at FuluForkEpoch (rpc_data_column_sidecars_by_root.go:170), establishing that blobs and data columns are mutually exclusive. Missing upper-bound check allows blob_sidecars_by_range to serve Fulu-epoch blobs when it should reject them.
audit_items.attack_scenario: During fork transition, attacker requests blob_sidecars_by_range with start=pre-Fulu slot, count=large. Handler serves blobs for both pre-Fulu AND Fulu slots because validateBlobsByRange only checks rp.end <= current without capping at FuluForkEpoch. Peers receive deprecated blob data for Fulu blocks instead of data columns.
